title: Doctor checks each project's check command and patterns (docs/design.md:613-614)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Doctor checks slicer, adj and the contract, but not each project's check command or patterns (design.md:613-614, "later"). Doctor does not read the registry today: internal/cli/doctor.go has no registry import. The fields are in registry.Project: worktree_pattern (registry.go:76), branch_pattern (:77), check_command (:78). design.md:618-619 says doctor exits 1 only for slicer, adj or the contract.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/cli/doctor.go` (DoctorReport at :30-38 gets a per-project list; checks load the registry).
- `internal/registry/registry.go:76-78` (fields read); :184 validates Cap, CheckMinutes and budgets, not patterns, so pattern checks are new.
- `internal/cli/cli_test.go:583-756` (doctor tests; add per-project tests beside them).
- `docs/design.md:613-614`; `docs/state.md:58-59` (check command source).
Open: whether a project finding changes doctor's exit code (design.md:618-619 says no today).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestDoctorChecksEachProjectCheckCommand: the command's executable is found on PATH.
- TestDoctorReportsProjectWithMissingPath.
- TestDoctorPatternWithoutIdIsReported (the {id} rule is new, so proposed).
- TestDoctorProjectWithoutCheckCommandIsNotAnError.
- TestDoctorJSONListsEachProject.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): a project finding does not change doctor's exit code; it stays 0 (design.md:618-619).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/cli ./internal/doctor (re-anchor the package); go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
